verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe a Transactional API for one-off sends like password resets and purchase receipts (docs-25, docs-14), alongside the same platform's broadcast/marketing APIs (docs-23), and an App API that unifies sending broadcasts, transactional messages, and data fetches. This confirms transactional and marketing sends coexist on one API platform. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the transactional API in production use and more detail on rate limits/reliability for transactional traffic specifically.
